|game_text=Deploy on opponent's just deployed character. Once per turn, if a bounty hunter here, may reveal the top card of each player's Reserve Deck. If this character about to be captured, retrieve 2 Force (3 if The Client on table) and return this card to your hand. [Immune to Control.]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[The Client's Bounty]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee repository image of the original state. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Client's Bounty (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 3, file created 10 August 2025: “Deploy on opponent's just deployed character. Once per turn, if a bounty hunter here, may reveal the top card of each player's Reserve Deck. If this character about to be captured, retrieve 2 Force (3 if The Client on table) and return this card to your hand. [Immune to Control.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[The Client's Bounty]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[The Client's Bounty]] (repository revision 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•The Client’s Bounty”; the printed face matches the image in artwork, wording and visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
